parameters.name: BindingType
parameters.description:
The type of the object that you want to unbind from the source exchange. Valid values:

*   **QUEUE**
*   **EXCHANGE**

parameters.name: DestinationName
parameters.description: The name of the object that you want to unbind from the source exchange.

parameters.name: SourceExchange
parameters.description: The name of the source exchange.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun amqp-open delete-binding --instance-id amqp-cn-v0h1kb9nu000 --virtual-host test --source-exchange NormalEX --destination-name DemoQueue --binding-type QUEUE --binding-key .test. --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun amqp-open DeleteBinding --region cn-hangzhou --SourceExchange NormalEX --InstanceId 'amqp-cn-v0h1kb9nu000' --BindingType QUEUE --BindingKey '.test.' --DestinationName DemoQueue --VirtualHost test
